03

Our Story

How we met, in four moments.

2021 — A Gallery Opening. We met in front of the wrong painting. Zara was explaining a photograph; Kabir was pretending to understand it. She caught him. He laughed. They left together and talked until the gallery closed.

2022–2025 — The City Habit. Every free weekend became the city — galleries, bookshops, and long lunches with notebooks open. Zara edits; Kabir photographs. The habit never stopped.

November 2026 — On a Rooftop. On a clear evening above Soho, with the city lit below, Kabir asked properly, ring in a jacket pocket. Zara said yes, then made him ask again so the skyline could be in the photo.

10 April 2027 — Today, With You. Bold type, red accents, and the people who made us who we are. That is the whole plan — and the only thing missing is you.

Getting Here

John F. Kennedy Airport (JFK)

Nearest airport. Allow about 45–60 minutes by car to Soho in normal traffic — book your ride in advance for the main evening.

Parking & Shuttle: Parking is available at the venue where noted in the FAQ. There is no arranged shuttle between hotels, so please plan a ride for each evening and pre-book for late returns.

08

Questions, Answered

Tap a question to open it.

Are children welcome?

Children are welcome at the brunch, but the evening ceremony and dinner are adults-only, so parents can dance until late. Please tell us in the RSVP if this changes your plans.

Can I bring a plus-one?

Only if your invitation names a plus-one, or you have confirmed one with us directly. If unsure, write it in the RSVP message and we will confirm — seating is planned by name.

Where do I park?

No parking at the loft — please use the subway or a taxi. The nearest station is a five-minute walk; pre-book your ride home for after midnight.

What should I wear?

Modern formal: black, white, one red accent welcome. No casual wear, no trainers — the loft dress code is part of the evening.

Should I bring a gift?

No gift is expected — your presence is the gift. If you wish to give, a honeymoon contribution is welcome; ask us personally for details.

What about weather and terrain?

April in New York is mild but changeable — the loft is fully indoors, but the walk from the station is outdoors. Bring a light layer; the cloakroom is free.

A Note on Gifts

Your presence is the gift — truly.

If you still wish to give, a contribution towards our honeymoon is welcome, and we will share details personally with anyone who asks. There is no online registry or payment link on this page, by design.
